phase: Experimental reference planner redesign and robustness data preparation; PPO is not running.
training_source: PPO25u70; PPO30u10 checkpoint is preserved and not promoted.

PPO30_checkpoint.availability: Local only; full checkpoint and replay data are not in this source snapshot.

optimizer: Quasi-steady path/speed joint nonlinear optimizer; analytic circle and objective gradients pass. Dense feasibility gates currently reject the first Practice candidate.
robustness_preparation: 15 physical-wall mismatch variants prepared, keeping nominal map and reference path fixed; not yet trained.
two_car_requirement: Same track, separated simultaneous starting positions. Opposite positions do not imply head-on traffic. Actual opponent-occluded LiDAR plus scan-localizer validation remains to implement.
existing_randomization_retained: LiDAR range noise/dropout/spikes; speed noise/scale; steering delay/lock/response; acceleration/braking/friction; synthetic localization offset/jumps/loss; varied geometry and open pockets.
performance_claim: No new lap-time/completion improvement claimed from this work. Planning proxy times are not simulator or real-car lap times.
large_artifacts: Model weights, optimizer checkpoints, replay arrays and generated maps remain local; reproduction needs the source data paths and environment described in the plan.
quota_rule: Stop work and jobs when fresh 5h usage remaining drops below20%.
